data.segment_title: Preview/Introduction Tom Brokaw (Republican National Convention in New York)
Decision 2004 / Republican Convention / Gay Marriage / Parties
data.segment_description:
(New York: Tom Brokaw) Day 2 of the Republican National Convention in New York, where California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger and First Lady Laura Bush will speak, noted. 
 (Convention floor: Brian Williams) The themes of compassion & inclusion at tonight’s convention featured; details given of President Bush’s turnaround on his statement that the war on terror is not winnable; scenes shown of delegates wearing bandages with purple hearts on them in a swipe at Senator John Kerry’s war record. [In Nashville, BUSH – says we are winning and we will win.] [Representative Charles RANGEL†- says this {Kerry’s military service} is nothing to play with politically.] [Last night, former New York City Mayor Rudolph GIULIANI – praises Bush’s actions after 9/11.] [Last night, Senator John McCAIN – criticizes “Fahrenheit 9/11” filmmaker Michael Moore.] 
 (New York: Tom Brokaw) Report introduced. 
 (Convention floor: Campbell Brown) The division within the Republican Party over the issue of same-sex marriage featured; details given about Vice President Dick Cheney’s divergence from Bush’s view. [McCAIN – says we are Americans first, last & always.] [Family Research Council president Tony PERKINS†- says there are other faces to the party that are not being represented.] [Last week, CHENEY – speaks of freedom in relationships.] [Log Cabin Republicans Patrick GUERRIERO†- says the American people expect to find out where this party & this president stands.] 
 (New York: Tom Brokaw) Figures on corporate spending at the convention cited. 
 (New York: Lisa Myers) The lavish parties thrown by corporations & special interest groups during the convention featured; scenes shown. [Representative Dennis HASTERT – comments on a party thrown by GM in his honor.] [HHS Secretary Tommy THOMPSON††- denies being worried that a party for him was sponsored by drug company Novartis, which is affected by his decisions.] [Campaign finance reform advocate Fred WERTHEIMER†- says you’re looking for favorable treatment down the line.] [Partygoer Georgette MOSBACHER††- points out her party schedule.] [Lobbyist Ken KEYES‡- comments on hosting a party on his yacht.]

(New York: Tom Brokaw) A suicide bombing at a subway station in Moscow, Russia, by a woman who may be from Chechnya, reported; scenes shown.   (Beersheba, Israel: Tom Aspell) A double suicide bus bombing in Beersheba, Israel, featured; scenes shown of the burning buses, injured people, and of a man who was caught with a bomb under his clothes at the entrance to the Gaza Strip; video shown of the bombers; details given of the claim by Hamas that the bombings were retaliation for the killing of 2 of their leaders. [Palestinian spokeswoman Dr. Hana ASHRAWI†- condemns the attacks.] [Israeli police spokesman Gil KLEINMAN†- notes the protection from terrorists provided by the security fence in the north.]

data.segment_description: (New York: Tom Brokaw) Taped discussion held with former President George Bush about a variety of matters. [BUSH – responds to former National Security Advisor Gen. Brent Scowcroft’s criticism of the decision to go to war in Iraq; comments on President Bush’s acknowledgment that he miscalculated in Iraq; offers views on filmmaker Michael Moore, the "New York Times" & reporter Maureen Dowd; comments on the voting process in the presidential election.] Bush’s opinion on the “Swifties” {Swift Boat Veterans for Truth} ads attacking Senator John Kerry’s war record noted.
